summary_markdown: The discussion focused on integrating a component into the main data pipeline, specifically after the recalc step. A key concern raised was improving the script's robustness to handle failures at any stage (exit code handling for ClickHouse). Currently, the script only fails gracefully if downstream ML processes lack data, which is insufficient if partial but available data exists. The immediate need is to prevent technical distrust when presenting results to stakeholders (e.g., 'the French').
decisions: The component will be added to the main pipeline sequence after the recalc step.
action_items: Investigate and implement proper exit code handling for ClickHouse within the script to ensure failure at any stage causes a controlled script drop.
